props.title: You Deploy an AI Agent on Tuesday. Nobody Tells You What Wednesday Looks Like.

props.text: Eighty-eight percent of AI agent pilots never reach production. This article walks through what the other twelve percent actually looks like — day by day, from the perspective of someone who forks an autonomous agent framework and watches it come alive. Grounded in MiroShark's 199-day run and the second Aeon fork that appeared last week, it maps the lived experience of deploying an agent to the industry's production gap data.
